data_type.description: Data type of the vectors to be inserted into the vector index. Valid values: `float32`.

dimension.description: Dimensions of the vectors to be inserted into the vector index.

distance_metric.description: Distance metric to be used for similarity search. Valid values: `cosine`, `euclidean`.

vector_bucket_name.description: Name of the vector bucket for the vector index. The following arguments are optional:

region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

encryption_configuration.description: Block for encryption configuration for the vector index. See [`encyption_configuration` block](#encyption_configuration-block) below.

metadata_configuration.description: Block for metadata configuration for the vector index. See [`metadata_configuration` block](#metadata_configuration-block) below.

tags.description: Key-value map of resource tags. If configured with a provider [`default_tags` configuration block](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#default_tags-configuration-block) present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.
